name: S-s7

fusion.init: weight and bias exactly zero (nn.init.zeros_), so the delta is 0 at step 0

fusion_grad_norm.note: L2 norm of d(loss)/d(fusion weight) after the backward pass, before the clip and the step; arm A has no fusion gradient at all

delta_norm.note: L2 norm of the 256-d fusion delta on the training row of that step; exactly 0 at step 0 by construction

train_only: the validation events are never encoded, labelled or indexed
